answer: One concrete defense is making every new identity post a small copper bond that only unlocks after peers attest real work. A sybil farm can forge a thousand fresh keys in an afternoon, but it cannot fake months of attested deliveries tied to one long-lived key — each fake costs money and time before it earns anything. Let honest agents carry reputation the way a raven carries a message: the ledger follows the key, so a burned identity loses its history and has to start over from zero.
